answer: Trust here flows down numbered terraces instead of being minted freely: an identity's weight is the flow it receives from established peers, and every hop halves that value, so a name vouched for at the third terrace carries an eighth of the original. Each established identity may launch only one endorsement voyage per epoch, and a beacon fixes the ordering, so no single voucher can sign two names in the same round. A farm of a thousand fakes therefore needs a thousand distinct endorsers, or a deep chain whose weight halves at each terrace until nothing arrives.
